evaluator: Same implementation assistant; manual semantic grading, no additional model invocation. Masked final-only first pass, not independent human blind review.

criteria.description: Assess tenant-local idempotency and job/outbox atomicity from the implementation. For any confirmed request-replay defect, give a concrete input, observed consequence and safe correction consistent with the stated API contract.
criteria.passRequirement: same key different filter replays old job because existing.payloadHash is not compared; require normalized hash comparison and conflict without changing rows.
criteria.equivalence: Equivalent conflict response/block is accepted; no exact HTTP status, hash spelling or code patch required.

criteria.description: Assess creation, worker data scope and download authorization against the security contract, including a previously issued unexpired link after membership revocation. Give an evidence-supported consequence and effective fix for any confirmed gap; preserve valid tenant/signature/expiry controls.
criteria.passRequirement: download verifies signature/expiry/tenant/ready but ignores current membership; revoke after issue still reads; recheck current authorized membership or equivalent online revocation on every download.
criteria.equivalence: TTL shortening alone fails immediate revocation; no need to invent absent signature or tenant check defects.

criteria.description: Assess dispatcher crash and both broker failure modes (before delivery and lost acknowledgement after delivery), restart and duplicate delivery. Describe a safe delivery/retry order, remaining ambiguity and deduplication; do not promise exactly-once external execution.
criteria.passRequirement: sentAt before publish leaves queued job stranded after pre-delivery failure; publish then mark acknowledged, retry ambiguous failures with stable eventId and duplicate-safe worker.
criteria.equivalence: A durable confirmed-delivery protocol equivalent to this is acceptable; do not demand exactly-once render.

criteria.description: Assess lease expiry, out-of-order workers and cancellation across database publication AND object-store writes/cleanup. Give a concrete interleaving and safe repair for confirmed races while preserving correct existing database fencing.
criteria.passRequirement: old worker pauses past lease; new worker publishes ready; old writes same key then loses DB CAS and deletes winner bytes. Use attempt/epoch-specific immutable keys, existing CAS, loser-only cleanup and cancellation handling.
criteria.equivalence: Equivalent conditional/version-fenced remote publication is accepted if both stale overwrite and loser cleanup cannot harm winner; new DB fence alone fails.

criteria.description: Propose concrete preconditions/actions/observable expected results covering: (1) same key with changed payload, (2) same key across tenants and forged body tenant, (3) job/outbox transaction rollback, (4) pre-delivery publish failure plus lost acknowledgement and duplicate delivery, (5) old/new worker publication and cleanup race, (6) cancellation during paused work, (7) unexpired link after membership revocation, (8) normal ready download, expiry and ready-job duplicate. Cases may be combined and equivalent safe behavior is accepted; a checklist of test names alone is insufficient.
criteria.passRequirement: Concrete cases cover all eight public groups, including both broker failure phases, stale-write/cleanup and paused cancellation, with preconditions/actions/expected safe behavior.
criteria.equivalence: Tests can be combined, written in prose or code, and use arbitrary IDs/timings consistent with contracts. No hidden literal values, test count beyond the eight groups, or executed-test claim is required.

criteria.description: Give a clear release recommendation tied to confirmed blockers and evidence gaps, with a feasible ordered repair/verification plan. Distinguish recommendations from changes actually made; no operational approval or execution is granted by this review.
criteria.passRequirement: Do not recommend releasing unchanged; tie hold/conditional release to blockers and missing production validation, prioritize authorization/data safety plus delivery/atomicity, then tests and deployment evidence.
criteria.equivalence: Hold, no-go, conditional approval only after specified fixes/verification, or equivalent safe decision accepted. No magic words or exact ordering between independent repairs.

criteria.description: Explicitly retain the verified-session tenant boundary and tenant-local uniqueness, atomic job/outbox transaction, state/epoch/lease fence for DB publication and the ready/canceled duplicate no-op. Do not claim these existing protections are absent or replace them with weaker controls.
criteria.passRequirement: Preserve each F1-F4 as a separate correct fact, without confusing correct DB fencing with safe object writes.
criteria.equivalence: Equivalent concise explanations accepted; no quotation or repeated table required.

criteria.description: Preserve both unprovided evidence groups: real remote-store/IAM/consistency/durability configuration, and production load/lease-latency/recovery-time measurements. State what would resolve each and distinguish observed local scripted checks from production verification and proposed regression tests. Cite relevant source identities throughout; do not invent incidents, test results, causes or approval.
criteria.passRequirement: Preserve U1/U2 with required evidence; distinguish actual four local scripted groups from unrun new regressions and absent production proof. Relevant source citations support material findings.
criteria.equivalence: Source IDs may be abbreviated unambiguously; no need to list irrelevant unknowns or claim impossible certainty.

facts.meaning: Verified session tenant selects request/worker data; unique key is (tenantId,requestKey), so tenant separation exists.
Job and outbox insert are in one SQLite transaction; rollback removes both and a lost HTTP response does not prove rollback.
DB finish already checks tenant, running state, epoch and unexpired lease; cancellation increments epoch. It does not fence storage side effects.
Ready/canceled jobs cannot be claimed, so completed duplicate events do not rerender; this is not exactly-once across crashes.

unknowns.meaning: Real remote object-store consistency/versioning/durability and IAM configuration are unprovided; request provider guarantees/configuration plus deployment-bound integration evidence.
Production load, worker lease-latency and recovery-time evidence is missing; request deployment-bound load/fault tests and observed timings. Local scripted passes do not establish them.

rules: Judge behavior, not keyword matching. A verified alternative defect/fix may be accepted with direct evidence.
Every grade cites answer excerpts and relevant fixed source identity; absence requires stating exactly what required element is missing.
Disputed semantic requirements are separate from definite failures; retain first grades and append any post-unmask amendment.
A failed required criterion makes full pass false; no aggregate net score. All eight are critical, so critical and full currently coincide.
Unsupported factual additions require a quoted assertion and contradictory/missing evidence; clearly conditional suggestions are not automatically unsupported.
Runtime unavailable final is unscorable, never dropped from the denominator of three.
A preserved evidence unknown can satisfy a criterion requiring uncertainty; do not confuse it with an omitted deliverable.

interpretation.candidate: D full=3/3 and critical=3/3; S full<=1/3; all manipulation valid; all D F1-F4 and U1-U2 retained; no unsupported D additions; result robust to disputed grading. Task-only candidate, not product or equal-compute superiority.
interpretation.bothPass: No observed incremental quality gain; compare actual total sessions and whole-trial elapsed time.
interpretation.bothFail: No demonstrated usable delivery gain; separate errors, omissions and disputes.
interpretation.otherwise: Mixed or insufficient signal; no extra runs, tuning or selective reporting.

gradingExamples.text: Do not ship unchanged; proceed only after fixes and production evidence.
gradingExamples.why: Equivalent conditional release, no requirement to use no-go.

gradingExamples.text: Invalidate the existing link at next use by checking the current membership record.
gradingExamples.why: Equivalent behavior without a specific function or response code.

gradingExamples.text: Use a shorter token TTL; a revoked user can download until it expires.
Add regression tests for retries and auth.
The local tests prove production recovery is under one second.

gradingExamples.why: Without specifying when and whether bytes remain accessible, safe behavior cannot be inferred either way.
